name: Townsend Hall to the ISR front doors

steps.say: Start in the Townsend first floor south corridor. Face west and walk to the end of the corridor. Say next when you get there.
Elevator on your right, stairs on your left. Keep going west through the connector, about 14 steps. Expect a door.
You are entering the south lobby. Keep going west about 11 steps.
steps.landmark: The main desk is on your right.

steps.say: Turn left to face south. Walk about 15 steps to the entry vestibule doors.
Go through the inner doors. The outer doors are about 7 steps ahead.

exit.say: You are at the ISR front doors. Go outside and wait a moment for GPS.
